detailed_description: YAML Formatter is a comprehensive online tool for formatting and validating YAML files. It automatically fixes indentation issues, validates syntax, and beautifies your YAML configuration files. The tool supports complex nested structures, arrays, multi-line strings, and multi-document YAML files. Perfect for DevOps engineers working with Kubernetes manifests, CI/CD pipelines, or any YAML-based configuration. Get instant feedback on syntax errors and produce clean, properly indented YAML output.
